summary.intent: Monitor PR #392 for incoming automated reviews from Copilot and CodeRabbit, resolve all review comments, then fix a release gate bug where test: commits were not requiring E2E verification before release-please PRs could merge.
summary.outcome: All 3 review comments (1 Copilot, 2 CodeRabbit) were fixed, committed, and resolved. A new ci-e2e.yml orchestrator workflow was created to unify change detection and conditionally run web/desktop E2E, with the release gate updated to poll the orchestrator. The retrigger mechanism ensures stale release-please gate passes are invalidated when new commits land on main.

repo: Release gate only enforced E2E for release-please--* branches; non-release PRs auto-passed with 'Not a release PR — E2E gate not applicable', creating a silent merge gap
test: and chore: commits don't trigger release-please to update the release PR, meaning the gate could pass green and then never re-run when those commits landed
desktop-e2e.yml already used dorny/paths-filter + conditional job pattern; web e2e.yml did not — the two were inconsistent
E2E runs were unconditionally triggered on every push to main regardless of what changed, wasting CI minutes
Committed fixture files (test-audio.mp3, test-document.pdf, test-video*.mp4) live in tests/web-e2e/fixtures/files/ and must not be overwritten by test helper functions
The createTestMediaFile/createTestImageFile/createTestTextFile/createTestBinaryFile helpers lacked guards against overwriting committed fixtures during cleanup

code.finding: Added COMMITTED_FIXTURES guard to all createTest*File helpers to prevent cleanup from deleting committed fixture files when test-generated file name matches a fixture
Missing faro_enabled: true metadata field in baseline JSON — CodeRabbit caught this as a schema gap
page.evaluate() called without page.isClosed() guard in teardown, which would throw if the page was already closed
gh run rerun needed to filter for status == completed before retrying, otherwise it may attempt to rerun an in-progress run
retrigger-release-gate job was missing pull-requests: read permission needed to list open release-please PRs

workflow: Polling for bot reviews with background bash tasks (sleep + gh api) is fragile — CodeRabbit has quota cooldowns (~23 min) that require adaptive polling intervals
When a required check auto-passes for certain PR types, it becomes a false safety net — required checks must fail loudly or not run at all, never silently pass
Using workflow_call to invoke reusable workflows from an orchestrator keeps individual workflow files clean and avoids duplicating push triggers and path filters
After resolving review comments, REST API requires integer comment ID for in_reply_to (--field not -f), while GraphQL thread IDs use string node IDs — these are different identifiers

friction: CodeRabbit rate-limited for ~23 minutes after initial review request, requiring ~40 minutes of polling before its review arrived
Confusion between REST comment IDs (integers) and GraphQL thread node IDs (strings) required extra API calls to look up correct IDs for reply vs resolve operations
First fix attempt (PR #393) solved the wrong problem — tried to run E2E on feature PRs instead of addressing the stale gate on release PRs; PR had to be closed and redone
Second fix attempt (PR #394) also initially missed the root cause, then required a user correction to understand the real issue was the gate not re-running after test: commits landed
Background poll tasks proliferated (20+ tasks) making it hard to track which polls were still relevant vs stale
open_items: ci-e2e.yml orchestrator was committed but the session ended before the PR was created for the orchestrator refactor — unclear if that branch was pushed and PR opened
release-gate.yml was updated to poll ci-e2e.yml but the full verification of the new orchestrator flow in production hasn't happened yet

The retrigger-release-gate job re-runs the gate workflow but doesn't verify that the re-run actually sees the new MAIN_SHA — worth validating this end-to-end once the orchestrator PR merges
